prompts.prompt-r1.txt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Jason D’s Vision location master source, wide landscape, later cropped to 16:9 and centered 4:5.
Primary request: An original photorealistic artistic interpretation of the Alcazaba of Málaga at 22:33 Europe/Madrid on 23 September 2026, seen from the public Calle Alcazabilla / Roman Theatre forecourt at eye level looking east-northeast. It is Night. Open-Meteo model valid 22:30: clear, 22.3°C, 5% cloud, no precipitation, 4.3 km/h wind; model data, not an on-site observation. Sun below horizon at elevation -27.98°, azimuth 293.54°; no direct sunlight.
Scene/backdrop: The low semicircular Roman Theatre stone seating fills the immediate lower foreground. Beyond, a scrubby Mediterranean slope with palms and scattered dark trees rises to the Alcazaba: a long irregular band of genuine-looking ochre-brown stone and brick defensive walls, compact square towers, battlements and layered ramparts. Subordinate city buildings at far left and right only.
Composition/framing: Realistic ground-level distant view, not aerial. The principal theatre-to-fortress ensemble occupies no more than the central 42% of the 16:9 canvas, with generous dark sky headroom and plaza/theatre foreground, so a centered portrait crop retains the main towers, ramparts and theatre. Keep the fortress low and elongated along the hill, not a giant fantasy castle.
Lighting/mood: Clear dry Mediterranean night with only a few faint clouds and no stars or moon. Restrained warm architectural grazing light may reveal the principal walls and Roman Theatre, based on historical photos, but tonight’s operating schedule is unverified: keep deep natural shadows and avoid theatrical orange saturation. Dry stone, no rain gloss.
Constraints: Architecturally plausible Málaga Alcazaba exterior; weather and scene time must remain honest. No readable signs, brands, banners, crowds or identifiable people. No cathedral, no Alhambra, no oversized minarets, no invented palace dome, no fireworks. No text, caption, signature, frame or watermark; labels will be added deterministically later.
